weapon.d: Grants Atk+3. At start of combat, if unit's HP ≥ 25%, grants Atk/Spd/Def/Res+5 during combat, grants weapon-triangle advantage against colorless foes and inflicts weapon-triangle disadvantage on colorless foes during combat, and also, unit makes a guaranteed follow-up attack.

assist.d: Grants Def+4 to target ally for 1 turn.
Grants Def/Res+3 to target ally for 1 turn.
Grants Def/Res+6 to target ally for 1 turn.

a.d: At start of combat, if unit's HP = 100%, grants Atk/Def+3, but if unit attacked, deals 1 damage to unit after combat.
At start of combat, if unit's HP = 100%, grants Atk/Def+4, but if unit attacked, deals 1 damage to unit after combat.
At start of combat, if unit's HP = 100%, grants Atk/Def+5, but if unit attacked, deals 1 damage to unit after combat.
At start of combat, if unit's HP ≥ 25%, grants Atk/Def+7, but if unit attacked, deals 5 damage to unit after combat.

c.d: Inflicts Atk/Res-2 on foes within 2 spaces during combat.
Inflicts Atk/Res-3 on foes within 2 spaces during combat.
Inflicts Atk/Res-4 on foes within 2 spaces during combat.
Inflicts Atk/Res-4 on foes within 3 spaces during combat.
